---
title: Interactive Rmd
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
>instructions "runtime:shiny", that doesn't allow 
---
  
```{r, echo = FALSE}
##different widget that allows for us to interact with called the "interactive interface"
numericInput("n",
"How many cars?", 5)

##code that is listening to any changes, run (execute the head demand for cars)
##"input$n" is the number of cars
renderTable({
head(cars, input$n)
})

numericInput("my_widget",
"How many cars?", 5)
renderTable({
head(cars, input$my_widget)
})
```
